_source: Market days, times and addresses are verbatim from brandywinefisheries.com/farmers-market-booths/. Season windows are the published operating seasons of each market organization (not Brandywine claims) and are marked as such on the page. County/population context is public record.

locations.name: Brandywine Fisheries Retail Store
locations.blurb: The only Brandywine counter open seven days a week. Everything the markets carry, plus the things that don't travel to a booth — fresh oysters, hot clam chowder by the cup, and the full canned and smoked shelves.
locations.context: Main Street in east Springfield, on the way out toward Thurston and the McKenzie Highway. Parking is off-street.
locations.drive_note: About ten minutes from downtown Eugene, five from Gateway.

locations.name: Lane County Farmers Market — Saturday
locations.address: Park Blocks at 8th & Oak St., Eugene, OR
locations.season: The Saturday market runs year-round at the Park Blocks; the outdoor season is the busiest stretch.
locations.blurb: The big one. Six hours, the full smoked case, and whatever came off the boat that week.
locations.context: Downtown Eugene between the Park Blocks and the Farmers Market Pavilion, eight blocks from the river.
locations.drive_note: Roughly 15 minutes from the Springfield store.

locations.name: Lane County Farmers Market — Tuesday
locations.address: Park Blocks at 8th & Oak St., Eugene, OR
locations.season: Tuesday is the seasonal midweek market — it runs spring through fall rather than all year.
locations.blurb: The midweek stop. Smaller than Saturday, quieter to shop, same case.
locations.context: Same Park Blocks corner as Saturday, at a fraction of the crowd.
locations.drive_note: Roughly 15 minutes from the Springfield store.

locations.name: Corvallis Farmers' Market
locations.season: The riverfront Saturday market season runs mid-April through late November.
locations.blurb: Four hours on the Willamette riverfront. A shorter window than Eugene, so the popular cuts go early.
locations.context: Riverfront Commemorative Park along 1st Street, downtown Corvallis.
locations.drive_note: About 45 minutes up the valley from Springfield.

locations.name: Bend Farmers Market
locations.address: Brooks Alley Way, downtown Bend, between Franklin and Brooks Street
locations.season: The downtown Bend market runs a summer-into-fall season rather than year-round.
locations.blurb: The long haul. Coast fish carried over the Cascades to the high desert the same week it landed.
locations.context: Brooks Alley along Mirror Pond in downtown Bend.
locations.drive_note: Bend is a three-hour drive from the coast side of the operation — which is the whole reason a never-frozen boat that docks often matters out here.

locations.name: Portland Farmers Market at PSU
locations.address: SW Park and Montgomery, Portland, OR
locations.season: The PSU market runs year-round, with the full-size season from spring through fall.
locations.blurb: The earliest start of the week. On the South Park Blocks at Portland State.
locations.context: The South Park Blocks between SW Park and Montgomery on the PSU campus.
locations.drive_note: About two hours north of Springfield.

locations.name: Charleston, Oregon — home port
locations.when: Not a retail location — this is where the boat works from.
locations.blurb: The F/V Brandywine was hand-built here and still runs out of Charleston harbor as one of its core independent boats.
locations.context: Charleston sits at the mouth of Coos Bay on the southern Oregon coast, one of the state's working commercial harbors.

region: Willamette Valley, central Oregon, and the southern Oregon coast
climate_note: The valley runs wet from November through April and dry from June through September — which is why market season, not the calendar, is how most of our customers think about the year.
